phase: Phase 2 - original clean object target (independent of Phase 1)
objective: Reconstruct the original clean preprocessed 64x64 onion object from reduced-shot DGI.
input: clipped calibrated DGI-N (N = 500, 1000, 2000, 5000) only; the clean object is never an input
target: original clean preprocessed object (src.ghost_imaging.load_object, 64x64, linear luminance, [0,1])

training.sequences: 32 per training image, seed 20,000,000 + 1000k + i; one realisation per image per epoch via default_rng([0, epoch])
training.selection: 75 validation images x seeds 2040-2042 (Phase 1 selection_val.npz, read-only); target = clean object

evaluation.target: original clean object (used only after reconstruction)

fidelity_criterion.definition: AI-original-N reaches high fidelity if, on paired differences [metric(AI-original-N, clean) - metric(DGI-10000, clean)] pooled over seeds 2026-2029, the lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI (2000 resamples over images, seeds kept together) is >= -0.02 for SSIM and >= -0.01 for Pearson r (non-inferiority to conventional 10,000-shot DGI)
fidelity_criterion.minimum_N: smallest N meeting the criterion; reduction factor = 10000 / N
fidelity_criterion.decided_on: validation first; frozen (checkpoint MD5s) before the single test evaluation

notes: DGI-10000 is the conventional high-shot baseline, not ground truth.
The 74 test images were already evaluated in Phase 1 (against the 10k reference, plus a supplementary clean-object analysis of Phase 1 outputs); Phase 2 does not train or select on them.
Phase 1 outputs are read-only and hash-checked before/after.
